title: Explosions on Buses in Central Israel
text:
• Israeli police reported a series of explosions on buses in central Israel on February 20, 2025.
• The explosions are believed to be a militant attack, but no injuries were reported.
• Explosives were found on two additional buses, prompting police to urge the public to report suspicious objects.
• The explosions occurred shortly after Hamas released the bodies of four Israeli hostages held in Gaza.
• Police forces were deployed to Bat Yam, a suburb of Tel Aviv, to search for suspects.
• Police spokesman Haim Sargrof stated that all buses and trains had been scanned for explosives.
• Sargrof indicated the need to determine if a single suspect or multiple suspects were involved.
• Bat Yam's mayor, Tzvika Brot, noted it was a miracle that no one was hurt, as the buses were in a parking lot after completing their routes.
• One unexploded bomb was being defused in the nearby town of Holon.
• The explosives matched those used in the West Bank, according to police, though details were not provided.
• Israel has conducted military raids on suspected Palestinian militants in the West Bank since Hamas' attack on October 7, 2023.
• Since the ceasefire in Gaza began on January 19, 2025, Israel has intensified military operations against Palestinian militants in the West Bank.
